channel.title: Journal — Awalim Group
channel.description: Engineering notes from real projects — not marketing content. What we learn while shipping, written down while it is still fresh.

item.title: The agent revolution: from tools to systems that act
item.description: Why the industry moved from a model that answers to an agent that executes — and what changes in engineering once the system is the one deciding the next step.

item.title: Building AI agents: from zero to production
item.description: The full path: choosing the model, designing the tools, managing memory — then what actually breaks when the agent meets real users.

item.title: Flutter and Apple's standards: building an experience at the level of official iOS
item.description: The differences a user notices without naming them: motion curves, scroll bounce and touch timing — and where they come from when they are not native.

item.title: Serverless on AWS: architecture that scales without limits
item.description: When serverless is the right call and when it is a trap — by the cost, the cold start and the ceiling, not by enthusiasm.

item.title: From idea to MRR: building a SaaS from zero in 8 weeks
item.description: A real timeline of what gets built and what gets postponed, and why scope kills small products faster than any technical mistake.

item.title: Sovereign Glass Design: beyond the blur
item.description: Glass is not an effect but a decision about light, depth and ground — and what makes it read as a material rather than as a filter.
